combats.name: Assassination Attempt in Royal Chamber
combats.flavor_quote: He was like a tiger among baboons as he leaped, side-stepped and spun, offering an ever-moving target

suggested_dnd_monsters.Conspirators: Knight (CR 3) for Gromel, Bandit Captain (CR 2) for leaders
suggested_dnd_monsters.Hired Assassins: Assassin (CR 8) or Bandit (CR 1/8) depending on skill

combatants.name: Conan
combatants.weapons: Sword (breaks on Gromel's helm), ancient battle-axe
combatants.armor: Partial plate armor (cuirass missing helmet and side-pieces)

combatants.name: Conspirators
combatants.armor: Gromel in full armor, others mostly unarmored

combats.setting: Royal palace chamber at night, Conan awakened from prophetic dream
combats.outcome: Conan kills at least 9 attackers including Volmana and Rinaldo; receives multiple wounds and lacerations; sword breaks on Gromel's helm

combats.name: Battle with Summoned Demon
combats.flavor_quote: Conan felt his soul shrivel and begin to be drawn out of his body, to drown in the yellow wells of cosmic horror

combatants.name: Conan
combatants.weapons: Broken sword shard marked with mystical phoenix symbol

combats.setting: Same royal chamber, immediately after first battle, surrounded by corpses and blood
combats.outcome: Demon kills Ascalante before reaching Conan; Conan slays demon with enchanted broken sword; only blood stain remains of creature

combats.name: Battle on the Plains of Shamu
combats.flavor_quote: Like gay-hued leaves after an autumn storm, the fallen littered the plain

combatants.name: Conan's Aquilonian Army
combatants.armor: Burnished helmets, gilt-worked mail, silver breastplates

combats.setting: Plains of Shamu, open battlefield with pools of curdling crimson blood
combats.outcome: Conan's army slaughtered through treachery; Conan paralyzed and captured by Tsotha-lanti's magic

combats.name: Conan vs. Satha the Giant Serpent
combats.flavor_quote: A drop of its venom felt like a white-hot dagger driven into his flesh

suggested_dnd_monsters.Satha: Giant Constrictor Snake (CR 2) with Purple Worm (CR 15) size/venom

combats.setting: Dark dungeon chamber beneath the Scarlet Citadel, complete darkness
combats.outcome: Conan survives by standing motionless; venom burns his thigh but does not kill him

combats.name: Dungeon Monster Encounters
combats.flavor_quote: The creature made obscene high-pitched tittering sounds
combats.setting: Underground tunnels and chambers of the Scarlet Citadel, filled with supernatural horrors
combats.outcome: Conan stabs Shukeli through prison bars; fights past dungeon creatures to escape

combats.name: Final Battle at Shamar
combats.flavor_quote: The combat was a steel maelstrom where plumes tossed high among the flashing swords
combats.setting: Near the city of Shamar, open battlefield
combats.outcome: Conan's forces triumph despite being outnumbered (superior Bossonian archers); Conan personally kills Strabonus by crushing his skull with a five-foot blade; Amalrus trampled in the charge; Conan decapitates Tsotha-lanti

combats.name: Tavern Brawl
combats.flavor_quote: Steel flashed and the throng surged wildly back out of the way
combats.setting: Tavern in the Maul district of Zamora's City of Thieves
combats.outcome: Brief violent exchange, crowd backs away from the fighting

combats.name: Garden Guard Assassination
combats.flavor_quote: A quick look to right and left showed him no enemy in sight at least
combats.setting: Outer gardens of the Tower of the Elephant, nighttime
combats.outcome: Conan silently kills the guard to gain entry

combats.name: Lions in the Garden
combats.flavor_quote: A long jet of yellowish powder shot from the tube and billowed out in a thick green-yellow cloud

combatants.name: Taurus of Nemedia
combatants.weapons: Black lotus powder (poison gas), climbing rope

combats.setting: Gardens surrounding the jewel-encrusted silver Tower of the Elephant
combats.outcome: Taurus kills several lions with black lotus powder; Conan kills one lion with his sword when it attacks Taurus

combats.name: Battle with the Giant Spider
combats.flavor_quote: Full in the midst of the branching black legs the massive missile struck, smashing against the wall
combats.setting: Upper chamber of the Tower of the Elephant, treasure vault, eerie ghostly atmosphere
combats.outcome: Spider kills Taurus with venomous bite; Conan crushes spider with thrown treasure chest and cuts himself free from webs

combats.name: Confrontation with Yara
combats.flavor_quote: He had an eery feeling that he was alone in a tower occupied only by ghosts and phantoms

combatants.name: Yara
combatants.role: Evil sorcerer lord of the tower

combats.setting: Topmost chamber of the Tower of the Elephant, mystical and otherworldly
combats.outcome: No physical combat; Yara is magically drawn into the gem and shrunk, trapped within by the power of Yag-kosha's dying curse

combats.name: Shevatas vs. Guardian Serpent
combats.flavor_quote: A serpent twenty feet long, with shimmering, iridescent scales

suggested_dnd_monsters.Guardian Serpent: Giant Constrictor Snake (CR 2) with magical properties

combats.setting: Ancient ruins of Kuthchemes, dark tomb chamber
combats.outcome: Shevatas defeats serpent with lucky sword thrust; later mysteriously killed by awakened sorcerer

combats.name: Battle of the Pass of Shamla
combats.flavor_quote: Wave after wave of glaring faces and flashing spears surged up the slope, a red sea with each wave a straggling line of corpses

combatants.name: Khorajan Army
combatants.armor: Mix of mail, leather, and shields

combats.setting: Pass of Shamla, steep slopes initially shrouded in magical fog, narrow mountain pass
combats.outcome: Conan uses pincer tactics; leads desperate cavalry charge down impossible slope; routs Natohk's army despite being outnumbered 3-to-1

combats.name: Infantry Melee at the Pass
combats.flavor_quote: Shields crashed against shields, and between them spears drove in and blood spurted
combats.setting: Slopes of the Pass of Shamla, grinding close combat
combats.outcome: Brutal grinding combat with blind gasping ferocity; tribesmen fight with supernatural courage, rushing on like madmen

combats.name: Conan's Cavalry Charge
combats.flavor_quote: Five hundred footmen on half-wild Shemite horses, charging an army down a slope where no cavalry had ever dared charge before, ripped through them as an avalanche cuts through a forest of saplings
combats.setting: Steep mountainside in the Pass of Shamla, impossible cavalry terrain
combats.outcome: Surprise flank attack shatters Natohk's forces; impossible cavalry charge succeeds and breaks enemy morale

combats.name: Conan vs. Natohk (Thugra Khotan)
combats.flavor_quote: The lurid desolate splendor of sunset
combats.setting: Battlefield littered with corpses at sunset, Pass of Shamla
combats.outcome: Conan throws his sword, striking Thugra Khotan beneath the heart; sorcerer's power fails and he dies, army collapses

stories.title: The Slithering Shadow (Xuthal of the Dusk)

combats.name: Conan vs. Xuthal Citizens
combats.flavor_quote: The citizens were brave but no match for Conan
combats.setting: Xuthal, a decadent dying city in the desert, drug-addled inhabitants
combats.outcome: Conan systematically defeats the male citizens despite their numbers

combats.name: Conan vs. Thog the Ancient Horror
combats.flavor_quote: He was tossed to and fro in the violence of that awful battle, and had a dazed feeling that he was fighting not one, but an aggregation of lethal creatures

combatants.name: Thog
combatants.role: Lovecraftian demon-god summoned from darkness between stars
combatants.weapons: Dark tentacles/pseudopods, crushing coils, supernatural resilience
combatants.armor: Shadowy form with wavering unstable outline, nearly invulnerable to physical damage

combats.setting: Dark chambers of Xuthal, mysterious phosphorescent glow, chasm/well nearby
combats.outcome: Most brutal battle in all Conan stories; closest Conan ever comes to death; receives hideous mortal wounds from tentacles; sword thrusts barely harm Thog; Conan pierces creature's toad-like head and throws it into chasm; mortally wounded Conan miraculously healed by golden life-giving elixir

stories.title: The Pool of the Black One

combats.name: Conan vs. Captain Zaporavo
combats.flavor_quote: Against his fighting-craft was matched blinding speed and strength impossible to a civilized man
combats.setting: Jungle on mysterious island, dreamy silence like an enchantment
combats.outcome: Brief but savage duel; Conan kills Zaporavo and becomes new captain

combats.name: Conan vs. Black Humanoid Creatures
combats.flavor_quote: Like a tiger leaps and strikes among his prey, Conan leaped and struck: thrice his blade flickered before any could lift a hand in defense

suggested_dnd_monsters.Black Humanoids: Cultist (CR 1/8) or Gray Slaad (CR 9) for alien nature

combats.setting: Green fortress courtyard on remote island, mysterious jade-colored pool with faint luminosity
combats.outcome: Conan clubs three creatures to death before they react; pirates join battle; heavy pirate casualties but black humanoids slain

combats.name: Battle with the Black Ones
combats.flavor_quote: The sound of the hacking swords was like that of butchers' cleavers, and the shrieks, yells and curses were appalling

suggested_dnd_monsters.Conan and Pirates: Gladiator (CR 5) for Conan, Bandit (CR 1/8) for pirates

combatants.name: Remaining Black Ones
combatants.role: Growth of Life from pits of blasphemous creation

combats.setting: Fortress courtyard, mysterious pool glowing with jade-colored depths
combats.outcome: Brutal melee with heavy losses; Conan slays leader who utters death-curse; pool erupts into geyser and chases survivors as they flee the island

combats.name: Prison Escape
combats.flavor_quote: Conan brained him with the beef bone, took his poniard and his keys, and made a leisurely departure
combats.setting: Prison cell in city-state
combats.outcome: Conan kills jailer with improvised weapon; takes poniard and keys; escapes

combats.name: Conan and Murilo vs. Thak
combats.flavor_quote: He was like a crimson and black nightmare as he rushed across the chamber, fangs bared

suggested_dnd_monsters.Thak: Ape (CR 1/2) with Wereraven intelligence (CR 2) or Ogre (CR 2)

combats.setting: Red Priest's house of death traps, elaborate mechanisms and glass barriers
combats.outcome: Epic battle; Conan locks legs around Thak's torso, butchering with poniard; Murilo strikes Thak with chair, stunning him; Conan plunges poniard to the hilt in Thak's heart; Conan streaming blood and gasping

combats.name: Conan vs. Nabonidus
combats.flavor_quote: Conan swiftly throws a stool at the priest's head

combatants.name: Nabonidus
combatants.role: Red Priest attempting to trigger poison gas trap

combats.setting: Chamber with poison gas trap controls in Red Priest's house
combats.outcome: Conan throws stool at Nabonidus's head, killing the priest before he can activate the death trap

combats.name: Naval Battle: Argus vs. Tigress
combats.flavor_quote: By Crom, man, if you don't get under way, I'll drench this galley in the blood of its crew!
combats.setting: Open seas off the Black Coast, ship-to-ship combat
combats.outcome: Conan dispatches several pirates with bow and sword; Argosean sailors overrun and killed; Belit orders crew to spare Conan; Conan joins Belit as her mate and co-leader

combats.name: Conan Fighting on the Argus
combats.flavor_quote: He moved in a blinding blur of steel. Spears bent on his armor or swished empty air
combats.setting: Deck of the Argus during boarding action
combats.outcome: Conan fights like a blur of steel, spears bend on his armor; multiple pirates killed before Belit intervenes

combats.name: Ambush in Ancient Ruins
combats.flavor_quote: With herculean labor they did so, and lifted out the mangled bodies of the four men
combats.setting: Ancient ruined city and temple on the Black Coast, mysterious and foreboding
combats.outcome: Trap collapses, four men mangled to death; crew decimated by supernatural attacks; water supply destroyed

combats.name: Conan vs. Apelike Creatures
combats.flavor_quote: He crushed a narrow skull with the pommel of his hilt, feeling the bone splinter

suggested_dnd_monsters.Apelike Creatures: Ape (CR 1/2) or Baboon (CR 0) with supernatural traits

combats.setting: Deck of the Tigress near ancient ruins
combats.outcome: Conan kills one with bow, crushes skull of another with sword pommel, fights remaining creatures

combats.name: Final Battle with Winged Horror
combats.flavor_quote: Just above the hips it caught the hurtling shape, and the knotted legs fell one way
combats.setting: Ancient ruins under moonlight, Belit's body hanging from tree
combats.outcome: Conan on verge of death; Belit's ghost intervenes; Conan cuts winged horror in half with massive sword stroke; avenges Belit's death

combats.name: Conan and Valeria vs. T-rex
combats.flavor_quote: Conan killed the Tyrannosaurus Rex with a spear dipped in the poisonous juice of Derketa's Apples

combatants.name: Tyrannosaurus Rex
combatants.armor: Thick scales, characteristics of Stegosaurus and Allosaurus

combats.setting: Dense jungle far south of civilized lands
combats.outcome: Tyrannosaurus Rex mauls their horses; Conan throws poisoned spear into Tyrannosaurus Rex's lower jaw; blinded beast pursues by scent; dies from poison seconds before devouring Conan

combats.name: Xotalanc Raid on Tecuhltli
combats.flavor_quote: Five dead dogs! Five crimson nails for the black pillar!

suggested_dnd_monsters.Xotalanc Raiders: Bandit (CR 1/8), Cult Fanatic (CR 2) for magic pipe user

combatants.name: Xotalanc Raiders
combatants.weapons: Scimitars, magical pipe that drives guards insane

combats.setting: Corridors and halls of Xuchotl, jade city with floors of red stone that smolder like flame, lighted by burning jewels
combats.outcome: Xotalancas use magical pipe to madden guards; Conan and Valeria help repel attack; five Xotalancas killed; five red nails painted on black pillar to mark deaths

combats.name: Corridor Ambushes
combats.flavor_quote: She killed the first who came within reach before he could strike a blow

combatants.name: Conan and Valeria
combatants.role: Fighting as pair in maze-like halls

combats.setting: Claustrophobic jade corridors of Xuchotl, labyrinthine passages
combats.outcome: Valeria kills first attacker before he can strike; Conan and Valeria dispatch several enemies quickly in close-quarters combat

combats.name: Battle with Tolkemec
combats.flavor_quote: Conan kills Tolkemec with a thrown dagger

combatants.name: Tolkemec
combatants.weapons: Magical wand that drains life force

combats.setting: Inner chambers of Xuchotl, ritual chamber
combats.outcome: Tolkemec interrupts Tascela's ritual with life-draining wand; Conan throws dagger, killing Tolkemec

combats.name: Final Confrontation with Tascela
combats.flavor_quote: Valeria ultimately kills Tascela by stabbing her in the back

combatants.name: Tascela
combatants.role: Ancient queen attempting to steal Valeria's life force

combats.setting: Ritual chamber in Xuchotl's depths, mystical atmosphere
combats.outcome: After Tolkemec's death, Valeria stabs Tascela in the back, ending the ancient queen's reign and the blood feud

combats.name: Battle at Valkia
combats.flavor_quote: The cliffs suddenly collapse, killing thousands in an avalanche of stone and earth

combatants.name: Conan
combatants.role: King of Aquilonia (paralyzed early in battle)

combatants.name: Valannus
combatants.role: Captain wearing Conan's armor as decoy

combats.setting: Plains near Valkia, open battlefield with deadly cliffs
combats.outcome: Conan paralyzed by summoned demon; Valannus killed in avalanche trap along with thousands; Aquilonian army routed; Conan captured and imprisoned

combats.name: Escape from the Iron Tower
combats.flavor_quote: Even in chains, Conan remained more dangerous than ten armed men
combats.setting: Iron Tower dungeon in occupied Aquilonia
combats.outcome: Conan escapes with Zenobia's help; kills or evades guards; begins quest to find Heart of Ahriman

combats.name: Battle in the Catacombs
combats.flavor_quote: In the darkness beneath the earth, ancient horrors still dwell

combatants.name: Conan
combatants.role: Treasure hunter seeking Heart of Ahriman

combats.setting: Ancient catacombs beneath ruins of Acheron, pitch darkness and ancient evil
combats.outcome: Conan fights through undead horrors; retrieves the Heart of Ahriman

combats.name: Final Battle for Aquilonia
combats.flavor_quote: The armies clash while sorcery rends the sky above

combatants.name: Xaltotun
combatants.role: Ancient sorcerer watching from King's Altar

combats.setting: Plains of Aquilonia, with Xaltotun observing from the King's Altar hill
combats.outcome: Almaric killed by Pallantides; Aquilonians sweep the field; Conan uses Heart of Ahriman to destroy Xaltotun; throne reclaimed

stories.title: Iron Shadows in the Moon (Shadows in the Moonlight)

combats.name: Conan vs. Shah Amurath
combats.flavor_quote: The kozaki had been treacherously cut down to a man, but Conan survived to take his revenge

combatants.name: Conan
combatants.role: Lone survivor of betrayed Free Companions

combatants.name: Shah Amurath
combatants.role: Turanian commander who betrayed Conan's allies

combats.setting: Marshlands near the Vilayet Sea, after the massacre of the kozaki
combats.outcome: Conan slays Shah Amurath; rescues Olivia from his clutches

combats.name: Conan vs. Giant Man-Ape
combats.flavor_quote: The dark figure that pursued Olivia was a nightmare made flesh, fanged and terrible

suggested_dnd_monsters.Giant Man-Ape: Ape (CR 1/2) scaled to Large size, or Ogre (CR 2) or Hill Giant (CR 5)

combats.setting: Mysterious island in the Vilayet Sea, ancient ruins
combats.outcome: Conan slays the creature that had been hurling boulders and stalking them

combats.name: Conan vs. Pirate Captain
combats.flavor_quote: He slays the pirate captain, an old rival, but is struck down by a stone from another pirate's sling
combats.setting: Island ruins near the Vilayet Sea
combats.outcome: Conan kills the captain but is knocked unconscious by a sling stone; pirates capture him and drag him to ruins

combats.name: The Iron Shadows Attack
combats.flavor_quote: Under the full moon, the statues came alive and slaughtered most of the crew

suggested_dnd_monsters.Iron Statues: Iron Golem (CR 16) reduced power, or Animated Armor (CR 1)

combats.setting: Ancient ruins on island under full moon, cyclopean architecture
combats.outcome: Iron statues massacre most of the pirate crew; Conan and survivors flee to the ship; statues return to dormancy

combats.name: Conan vs. Giant Python
combats.flavor_quote: The serpent of Xapur, cyclopean and ancient, guarded the resurrected fortress
combats.setting: Island of Xapur, within the mysteriously resurrected green fortress
combats.outcome: Conan slays the serpent after brutal combat

combats.name: Conan vs. Jehungir's Mercenaries
combats.flavor_quote: The trap was set, but Conan was no easy prey

combatants.name: Conan
combatants.role: Lured target fighting his way through

combats.setting: Fortress of Xapur, within cyclopean walls and towers
combats.outcome: Conan fights through mercenaries; heavy casualties on both sides

combats.name: Conan vs. Khosatral Khel (First Encounter)
combats.flavor_quote: His sword rebounded from the iron muscle of Khosatral's belly

combatants.name: Khosatral Khel
combatants.role: Resurrected ancient demon with iron flesh

combats.setting: Within the fortress chambers of Xapur
combats.outcome: Conan faster but unable to harm demon; uses tapestry to entangle Khel; escapes to plan new approach

combats.name: Conan vs. Khosatral Khel (Final Battle)
combats.flavor_quote: Only the sacred dagger could pierce the devil's iron hide

combatants.name: Conan
combatants.weapons: Sacred dagger (only weapon effective against Khel)

combatants.name: Khosatral Khel
combatants.armor: Impervious iron flesh (vulnerable only to sacred dagger)

combats.setting: Fortress of Xapur, climactic chamber
combats.outcome: Conan obtains sacred dagger; pierces Khosatral Khel's iron hide; demon vanquished; rescues Princess Octavia; fortress crumbles

stories.title: The People of the Black Circle

combats.name: Conan's Raid on Vendhyan Soldiers
combats.flavor_quote: The Afghulis swept down from the mountain passes like wolves
combats.setting: Foothills of the Himelian Mountains, northwestern Vendhya frontier
combats.outcome: Conan's raiders overwhelm the patrol; Conan kidnaps Princess Yasmina

combats.name: Ambush in the Mountain Pass
combats.flavor_quote: The rocks themselves seemed to come alive with screaming tribesmen

combatants.name: Rival Tribal Forces (Wazulis, Irakzai)
combatants.role: Competing clans attempting to capture princess

combats.setting: Narrow mountain pass in the Himelians, steep cliffs and treacherous terrain
combats.outcome: Chaos as three factions clash; Conan escapes with Yasmina through treacherous mountain routes

combats.name: Battle Against the Black Circle Disciples
combats.flavor_quote: The wizards sent their servants, but flesh and steel met sorcery

combatants.name: Conan
combatants.role: Invader of the Black Circle's mountain stronghold

combats.setting: Fortress peak of Yimsha, desolate mountain stronghold in the clouds
combats.outcome: Conan and Yasmina fight through disciples and mind-controlled guards

combats.name: Three-Way Battle for the Princess
combats.flavor_quote: Afghuli, Vendhyan, and Turanian steel clashed in the mountain pass

combatants.name: Princess Yasmina's Vendhyan Cavalry
combatants.role: Royal rescue force now allied with Conan

combats.setting: Mountain pass leading from Yimsha, strategic chokepoint
combats.outcome: Conan and Yasmina's combined forces defeat the Turanian army; uneasy alliance solidified

combats.name: Conan's Crucifixion and Survival
combats.flavor_quote: He killed an overeager vulture with his teeth while hanging on the cross
combats.setting: Desert crossroads, Tree of Death, brutal sun and vultures
combats.outcome: Conan survives a day of crucifixion through sheer endurance; rescued by Olgerd Vladislav and his Kozak outlaws

combats.name: Conan's Ten-Mile Test
combats.flavor_quote: Ride ten miles through the desert without water or die on the cross
combats.setting: Ten miles of burning desert between cross and Kozak camp
combats.outcome: Conan completes the impossible ride; earns respect and eventual leadership of Kozak band

combats.name: Kozak Raid on Khaurani Patrols
combats.flavor_quote: Under Conan's leadership, the outlaws became an army
combats.setting: Desert borderlands of Khauraun
combats.outcome: Conan transforms raiders into disciplined force; multiple victories against patrols

combats.name: Battle Outside Khaurani
combats.flavor_quote: The mercenaries expected lightly armed Zaugirs, but met Khaurani heavy cavalry instead

combatants.name: Khaurani Heavy Cavalry (Hidden)
combatants.role: Loyal nobles returning to save kingdom
combatants.armor: Full plate barding and heavy armor

combats.setting: Plains outside the city of Khaurani, open battlefield
combats.outcome: Conan's tactical deception succeeds; hidden heavy cavalry devastates mercenaries; Constantius forces routed

combats.name: Conan's Revenge on Constantius
combats.flavor_quote: The Tree of Death would bear new fruit
combats.setting: The same crossroads where Conan was crucified
combats.outcome: Conan crucifies Constantius on the same cross; perfect revenge achieved

stories.title: Jewels of Gwahlur (The Servants of Bit-Yakin)

combats.name: Infiltration of Temple Guardians
combats.flavor_quote: The ancient temple held more than jewels in its shadows
combats.setting: Ancient temple of Alkmeenon in Keshan, mysterious and trap-filled
combats.outcome: Conan stealthily eliminates several guards; discovers the oracle is a fraud

combats.name: Conan vs. Gray Apes (Servants of Bit-Yakin)
combats.flavor_quote: They were gray-haired and massive, the true guardians of the ancient jewels

suggested_dnd_monsters.Gray Apes: Ape (CR 1/2) with Pack Tactics, Large size

combatants.name: Conan
combatants.role: Caught in trap with deadly guardians

combatants.name: Gray-Haired Apes
combatants.role: Ancient servants of Bit-Yakin, true guardians

combats.setting: Inner chambers of temple, secret vaults beneath Alkmeenon
combats.outcome: Gray apes massacre Gorulga's party; Conan barely escapes; treasure remains guarded

combats.name: Escape with Muriela
combats.flavor_quote: He had seconds to choose between the girl and the priceless gems
combats.setting: Collapsing temple passages, narrow escape routes
combats.outcome: Conan abandons treasure chest to save Muriela; escapes temple; demonstrates his honor

combats.name: Pict Ambush on Patrol
combats.flavor_quote: We never heard them till they were on us. How can anything move so silently?

suggested_dnd_monsters.Conan: Gladiator (CR 5) or Scout (CR 1/2) with Ranger abilities

combats.setting: Dark primeval forest beyond the Black River, thick underbrush
combats.outcome: Most of patrol slaughtered in surprise attack; Conan and few survivors escape

combats.name: Race to Warn the Fort
combats.flavor_quote: The Picts were at their heels, silent death in the shadows
combats.setting: Dense forest trails, swamps, and undergrowth
combats.outcome: Conan and Balthus fight running battle; several Picts killed; warning delivered

combats.name: Battle Against Zogar Sag's Beast
combats.flavor_quote: It was no natural creature that the wizard sent
combats.setting: Fort Tuscelan at night, wooden palisade walls
combats.outcome: Conan slays beast; realizes wizard Zogar Sag commands Pict forces

combats.name: Siege of Fort Tuscelan
combats.flavor_quote: The Picts surrounded the fort in numbers that would ensure its fall
combats.setting: Fort Tuscelan on the frontier, wooden walls and limited supplies
combats.outcome: Fort holds but at great cost; Conan leads survivors in fighting withdrawal; frontier abandoned; Picts driven back across Black River

stories.title: Shadows in Zamboula (The Man-Eaters of Zamboula)

combats.name: Conan vs. Cannibal in the Inn
combats.flavor_quote: The unfortunate cannibal attempted to prey on a fully aware Conan and paid with his life
combats.setting: Cheap inn owned by Aram Baksh, Zamboula at night
combats.outcome: Conan kills cannibal; discovers room is trap for travelers

combats.name: Street Fight with Cannibals
combats.flavor_quote: Conan intervened, slaying the three blacks attacking the naked woman
combats.setting: Dark streets of Zamboula, city where cannibals roam freely at night
combats.outcome: Conan kills three cannibals; rescues Zabibi; learns of city's dark secret

combats.name: Conan vs. Baal-Pteor the Strangler
combats.flavor_quote: One of the few humans in the Conan stories to be a physical challenge for the main character

suggested_dnd_monsters.Baal-Pteor: Assassin (CR 8) or Thug (CR 1/2) with high Strength

combats.setting: Temple or building interior in Zamboula
combats.outcome: Brutal close-quarters combat; Conan barely victorious against physically superior opponent

combats.name: Conan's Revenge on Aram Baksh
combats.flavor_quote: He cut out Baksh's tongue and sliced off his beard, then turned him over to the hungry cannibals

combatants.name: Conan
combatants.role: Avenger with ironic sense of humor

combatants.name: Aram Baksh
combatants.role: Inn owner who fed travelers to cannibals

combats.setting: Streets of Zamboula at night
combats.outcome: Conan mutilates Baksh; delivers him to cannibals he employed; poetic justice served

combats.name: Pirate Siege of Valenso's Fort
combats.flavor_quote: Their mantlet rams the gates, and steel meets steel at the walls
combats.setting: Remote coastal fort on the Pictish shore, wooden palisade
combats.outcome: Fort defenders drive back pirates with arrows; siege equipment deployed; Zingaran ship spotted on horizon; pirates withdraw

combats.name: Three-Way Battle at the Fort
combats.flavor_quote: Pirates, Zingarans, and Picts converged on the fortress treasure
combats.setting: Coastal fort under multi-faction assault
combats.outcome: Chaos erupts; Strombanni and Zarono both killed; fort falls to Picts

combats.name: Conan vs. The Black Stranger
combats.flavor_quote: The demon from the sea brought death, but Conan brought steel
combats.setting: Fort interior during the chaos, dark chambers
combats.outcome: Conan vanquishes the demon; saves Belesa and Tina; escapes over fort walls as Picts overrun fortress

combats.name: Conan vs. Temple Guards
combats.flavor_quote: Conan swiftly draws his sword and cuts off a noble's head
combats.setting: Temple museum in civilized city, murder scene with locked doors
combats.outcome: Conan beheads attacking noble; soldiers attack but flee when scream pierces corridor

combats.name: Conan vs. Giant Serpent
combats.flavor_quote: Conan lunges, swinging wildly with his sword and slicing off the head

suggested_dnd_monsters.Giant Serpent: Giant Constrictor Snake (CR 2) with supernatural origin

combatants.name: Giant Serpent
combatants.role: Creature from opened sarcophagus, real killer

combats.setting: Museum chamber with sarcophagus, curtained areas
combats.outcome: Conan decapitates serpent; proves his innocence; reveals true murderer

combats.name: Battlefield Survival: Aesir vs. Vanir
combats.flavor_quote: Eighty men have perished in bloody combat, and Conan alone survives
combats.setting: Frozen battlefield in Nordheim, snow and ice, corpse-ridden
combats.outcome: All warriors dead except Conan and one Vanir; mutual massacre in the snow

combats.name: Conan vs. Heimdul
combats.flavor_quote: The two clash, and though Conan is struck hard on the helmet, he thrusts his sword into Heimdul's chest
combats.setting: Frozen battlefield among the dead
combats.outcome: Brief duel; Conan struck on helmet; thrusts sword through Heimdul's chest; last man standing

combats.name: Conan vs. Frost Giants
combats.flavor_quote: Her two frost giant brothers rise from the snow, but Conan's primordial ferocity prevails

suggested_dnd_monsters.Frost Giants: Frost Giant (CR 8) reduced power, or Ogre (CR 2)

combats.setting: Frozen wasteland, hours from battlefield, ambush site
combats.outcome: Despite exhaustion, Conan's barbarian ferocity allows him to swiftly cut down both giants

combats.name: Encounter with Atali
combats.flavor_quote: She calls on her father Ymir and vanishes in blue flame, leaving only her gossamer garment

combatants.name: Atali, Daughter of Ymir
combatants.role: Supernatural temptress who lures dying warriors

combats.setting: Frozen wastelands of Nordheim, snow and ice
combats.outcome: Conan catches her but she escapes by divine intervention; enveloped in blue flame; vanishes; Conan found by Aesir comrades holding only her garment
